name: English — Reversed Sicilian (1...e5)
description: Black plays 1...e5 against the English, giving White a Sicilian Defense structure with an extra tempo. The Four Knights variation leads to a strategic battle where White fianchettoes, exchanges on d5, and builds a flexible center with d3. Both sides compete for the d4/d5 squares and the long diagonal.

lines.name: English — Reversed Sicilian (1...e5)
lines.description: After 1.c4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.Nf3 Nc6 4.g3 d5 5.cxd5 Nxd5 6.Bg2 Nb6 7.O-O Be7 8.d3 O-O, White has the Reversed Sicilian structure: fianchettoed Bg2, flexible d3+e2 center, and an extra tempo compared to Black's Sicilian. White aims for e4 or a4+Be3 to seize space; Black holds e5 and targets d4 as a knight outpost. The position is rich in long-term strategic ideas.
